watchOut: Funding fee amounts are not stated.
name: Apex Capital
summary: Long-running trucking factor with recourse and non-recourse options, 24/7 funding and a free fuel card.
differentiator: Says no long-term contract, no monthly minimum and no application, setup or UCC filing fees, but lists a "funding fee" for sending money to your bank that "varies with each funding method" without stating amounts. Ask for the funding fee by method; it is the line that changes the real cost.

terms.transfers: Funding fees: a fee for sending funds to your bank, varies with each funding method
terms.otherFees: No application, setup or UCC filing fees
terms.speed: 24/7 instant funding, including nights, weekends and bank holidays
terms.fuel: Free fuel card; fuel credit lines from $2,500 for qualifying clients
